about.heroDesc: Where the ancestral mystique of Middle Eastern agarwood merges seamlessly with French classical perfumery traditions.
about.invisibleCrownDesc: At OUD_X, we believe a signature scent should never whisper when it can enchant. Each flacon is designed as an olfactory portrait—distilled in limited micro-batches using unadulterated botanical essences, wild-harvested resin, and pure amber crystals.
about.std1Desc: All blends are bottled at 30% to 38% pure extrait strength.
about.std2Desc: We partner exclusively with certified ethical foresters in Assam and Cambodia.
about.std3Desc: Extracts rest for a minimum of 180 days to achieve unparalleled smoothness.
about.std4Desc: Produced in limited runs of 500 bottles per harvest to ensure supreme quality.
about.masterNoseDesc: Crafted in collaboration with renowned master noses across Paris, Dubai, and Cairo to compose fragrances with unmatched emotional depth and relentless sillage.
about.perfumerQuote: "True oud is not merely a scent; it is an ancestral memory that clings to your aura. We formulate perfumes for those who seek to leave an unforgettable imprint wherever they tread."
about.perfumerRole: Master Nose & Creative Director, OUD_X Atelier

faqs.q: Are all OUD_X fragrances 100% authentic and certified?
faqs.a: Yes, unconditionally. Every flacon is directly bottled by our certified master perfumery ateliers with serial batch tracking numbers.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Extrait de Parfum and Eau de Parfum?
faqs.a: Extrait de Parfum features our highest oil concentration (30–38%), yielding profound sillage that lasts 14–24 hours on skin and fabrics. Eau de Parfum provides 18–22% oil concentration for a balanced daily projection.

faqs.q: How fast will my order arrive across Egypt?
faqs.a: Orders in Greater Cairo, Giza, and Alexandria arrive within 24–48 hours via our dedicated white-glove couriers. For express orders placed before 1 PM CLT, dispatch is accelerated.

faqs.q: What is your return & exchange guarantee policy?
faqs.a: We offer a 14-day return privilege on unopened, tamper-sealed fragrances. We also include complimentary scent testing strips with each bottle so you can evaluate the scent before opening the main flacon seal.
